message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV and JSON files and opens images without any schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or structural validation on the loaded data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths (config.data_dir, config.train_folds_path, etc.) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication present in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads labels from CSV and a class-to-target mapping but performs no distribution comparison, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset loading and sampling code contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms to defend against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained weights via `load_pretrain_weigths(model, pretrain_path)` and also downloads pretrained weights via `timm` (`'pretrained': True`) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads fold data and constructs datasets but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or model code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses AdamW/AdamP optimizers with standard AMP and EMA but does not import or apply any differential privacy library such as Opacus or TensorFlow Privacy.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although train/validation folds are split via fold indices, there is no held-out test set isolation enforced at evaluation time, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and only a single primary metric (weighted AUC) is used without independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: The inference/data-loading path (AlaskaDataset, get_test_data) simply opens image files and applies transforms with no shape, range, or schema validation before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction_transform applies softmax but there are no subsequent NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validations on the returned outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-classification model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
